kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يأتكل (form VIII)
# يَأْتَكِلُ (yaʔtakilu) /jaʔ.ta.ki.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# يَأْتَكِلَ (yaʔtakila) /jaʔ.ta.ki.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# يَأْتَكِلْ (yaʔtakil) /jaʔ.ta.kil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
